evidence.reason: DEPENDENCY_RE is the dependency-scan allowlist for co-installed units, and it already includes non-activation coupling directives such as PartOf and Conflicts. Systemd v257 recognizes PropagatesStopTo= and its inverse StopPropagatedFrom= as [Unit] dependency directives; omitting them lets the scan miss a relation where stopping a co-installed unit also stops the selected crq unit, allowing discovery to report supported=True. This is a completeness bug in the existing scan, not a new protection requirement.
